title: 유럽샤드 AoS 릴리즈 날짜
bodyHtml:
I've talked to our marketing group, and as far as I know, the release date for Europe is still Feb. 28th. I'm still waiting to get the final info on the participating retailers in Europe for the shroud promo as well, but I haven't received that yet.

As soon as I get some definite answers from Europe, you guys will be the first to know.

UOSS에 따르면 유럽샤드들의 AoS 릴리즈날이 2월 28일이라고 합니다.


p.s : 일본은 2월19일로 잡혀있습니다.
